06e60164a8f04dff.title: Damian's Not So Haunted House
06e60164a8f04dff.desc: Come for a 0% scary and 100% Halloween fun for all ages, specifically catered to the very youngest trick-or-treaters. The experience is like Disneyland's Haunted Mansion attraction turned into a Mickey Mouse Clubhouse episode. The Not-So-Haunted house is open to the public October 16-17, 22-24, and Oct 27 - Oct 31 from 5-8 PM. The event is put on by a mother fighting for her son's life. 7-year-old Damian is currently suffering from the rare and fatal genetic disease called ASMD (also known as Niemann-Pick Disease Type A or baby Alzheimer's). You can visit SaveDamian.com to read Damian's full story. Damian's mom is transforming her garage into Damian’s Not-So-Haunted house, complete with a photo spot opportunity, an engaging walkthrough, and Disneyland decor straight from Disney’s exclusive vault. You can read all about what to expect here. You can also support by buying shirts promoting the event here - they glow in the dark! All funds raised at the Not-So-Haunted House go to the Wylder Nation Foundation (WNF), which is the only organization laser-focused on developing the treatment needed to save Damian's life. This year’s goal is to raise $15,000, and we can accomplish it with…
